notes: Contract-validated form of CLAIM_TABLE.json. Every entry round-trips through schemas/claim_contract.Claim.from_dict(...). Each claim adds `scope_envelope`, `data_source`, and `sensitivity` blocks beyond the minimum schema for downstream pinning.

C000.observable: presence of seven scope dimensions in an automation / efficiency claim text
C000.rate_equation: d(admissibility)/d(scope_specification) = +1 if all seven dimensions present, else 0

bounds.spatial: any claim text passed to validate_scope_specification

conditions: claim text is in plain English
regex patterns for the seven dimensions can detect any acknowledgment
invalid_if: a primary-source claim that explicitly answers all seven scope questions AND publishes a measurable falsifier
measured_by: manual annotation of canonical pitch corpus
relational_web: feeds into every other C001-C032 verdict

C001.observable: trip-weighted mean pairwise Jaccard distance between same-OD waypoint sets
conditions: route log has at least 2 trips per OD pair
waypoint identifiers are stable (HD-mapped node IDs or equivalent)
invalid_if: working autonomous deployment with mean Jaccard distance > 0.20
sensitivity: definition of OD pair (city-pair vs site-pair)

conditions: task inventory enumerated against canonical 20-task list
automation_status assigned per task from {fully_automated, partially_automated, remote_operator, human_required}
invalid_if: documented end-to-end automation including pump operation at variable sites

C003.observable: per-route-mile infrastructure capex with existing-state discounts across 7 line items
C003.rate_equation: d(infra_capex)/d(route_mile) = sum(unit_cost_i * (1 - existing_pct_i)) + receiving_sites_per_mile * pad_cost + comms_per_5mi

bounds.spatial: per route-mile of dispersed-well service area

conditions: existing_*_pct values are in [0, 1]
unit costs are 2025 US dollars (override otherwise)
invalid_if: cost data showing dispersed-well infrastructure < vehicle fleet cost

C004.observable: lifecycle EROI vs production decline curve
conditions: decline_curve in fractional multipliers per year
energy_input and energy_output denominated consistently (joules)
invalid_if: profitable autonomous deployment on <3yr wells

C005.observable: secondary-market retention curve by equipment type
conditions: equipment_type in {conventional_class8, autonomous_retrofit, purpose_built_autonomous}
years_elapsed in [0, 10]
invalid_if: active secondary market at >40% retention

C006.observable: scope-collapse markers in pitch text vs scope-honest markers
C006.rate_equation: d(collapse_score)/d(pitch_length) = +1 per overreach marker, -1 per scope-honest marker

bounds.spatial: any pitch / press release / investor deck

conditions: pitch is in English
regex patterns include domain vocabulary
invalid_if: scope-honest deployment language in primary sources

C007.observable: wage suppression coincident with threat-narrative deployment
conditions: threat narrative active (regex match in regional press)
productivity_change_pct measurable from BLS data
invalid_if: wage data showing parity or increase post-automation
data_source: BLS Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages

C008.observable: lifecycle ratio of sensor-stack replacement cost to driver-performed monitoring labor cost
conditions: task list covers DOT pretrip + posttrip + mid-shift inventory
sensor cost envelope is 2025 US
invalid_if: deployed system showing <2x cost of driver-performed monitoring

C009.observable: set difference between human-only precursor catches and sensor-detected catches
conditions: human_caught and sensor_caught lists enumerated from same incident corpus
invalid_if: documented parity in catch rates for subtle/precursor failures

C010.observable: autonomous-to-human ratio of expected roadside-breakdown cost

bounds.spatial: single incident, all US route classes

conditions: failure_type in canonical taxonomy
location_remoteness in [0, 1]
invalid_if: insurance/operational data showing parity

bounds.scale: annual USD per vehicle per interface

conditions: interface inventory enumerated against canonical 7-item list
mobile_escalation_pct given
invalid_if: audited middleware lifecycle cost at <2x driver-mediated cost

C012.observable: expected annual cost of unhandled interface variants

bounds.spatial: across all customer / fuel / regulatory / roadside touchpoints

conditions: variant_count is the empirical count of distinct conventions seen in the field
miss_rate is per-interface autonomous handler coverage gap
invalid_if: autonomous deployment with documented handler coverage for >95% of field variants

C013.observable: distributed-labor annual cost per truck supported as fraction of replaced driver fully-loaded cost

bounds.spatial: per truck supported by the off-vehicle workforce
bounds.scale: fully-loaded USD per role per truck

conditions: stack includes remote operator, mobile tech, customer service, diagnostic specialist, compliance officer, ML-ops, data labeling
driver fully-loaded baseline is wages + benefits + payroll tax + per-diem
invalid_if: audited distributed-labor cost below 25% of replaced driver fully-loaded cost

C014.observable: annual value of CDL driver-exercised refusals under FMCSA / OSHA / STAA
conditions: refusal categories enumerated from canonical FMCSA / OSHA / STAA list
value_per_event reflects cost averted by the refusal
invalid_if: documented autonomous deployment with legally recognized refusal authority at parity with a CDL driver

C015.observable: expected unrecovered share across 7-participant liability stack
conditions: coverage_share sums to ~1 across the 7 participants
disclaim_probability per participant reflects current case law and insurance posture
invalid_if: settled liability chain with insurance markets pricing autonomous-specific coverage at less than 2x conventional rates

C016.observable: weighted override-resolution coverage across 7 historical override categories
conditions: override categories enumerated from historical driver-decision corpus
coverage_pct measurable from autonomous-system production logs
invalid_if: documented autonomous override-resolution coverage of >90% of historical driver override events

C017.observable: annual autonomous-vs-conventional cost ratio across 10 framework line items + 6 litigation categories
conditions: fleet_size given to compute per-truck premium
litigation probabilities reflect 2025-era case-law posture
invalid_if: deployed autonomous trucking operation showing legal and regulatory framework cost at <1.5x conventional, sustained over 3 consecutive years

C018.observable: weighted human domain expertise retention across 6 skill atrophy curves
C018.rate_equation: d(retention)/d(years_into_transition) follows SKILL_ATROPHY_CURVES per skill, weighted

bounds.spatial: human workforce in transition to AI-handled operations

conditions: skill_weights sum to ~1
atrophy curves are reliable for the target workforce
invalid_if: deployment where AI-dominant system experiences edge-case failure AND humans successfully recover without catastrophic cost

C019.observable: edge-case recovery cost (scaled by deskilling) vs apparent monoculture savings
conditions: edge_case_frequency_per_vehicle from operational data
retention pulled from C018
invalid_if: operational deployment where monoculture edge-case recovery cost is less than hybrid-redundancy steady-state cost

C020.observable: honest eROI vs apparent eROI for autonomous trucking
conditions: all energy stack categories included (truck, server, network, manufacturing, embodied)
amortization horizon explicit
invalid_if: audited end-to-end energy accounting showing autonomous eROI > 1.5 across server, manufacturing, extraction, and network energy stacks
data_source: LBNL US Data Center Energy Usage Report
IEA Networks and AI energy outlooks

bounds.spatial: fleet across whatever geographic footprint it covers

conditions: coefficients reflect the deployment's actual cost structure (not industry averages necessarily)
invalid_if: audited multi-scale deployment data showing total energy cost per ton-mile monotonically decreasing across at least three orders of magnitude of fleet size

C022.observable: ratio of institution size to optimal scale point

bounds.spatial: institution operating in an industry with an optimal scale point

conditions: optimal_size known (from C021 or domain study)
institution has discretionary capital allocation authority
invalid_if: institution-backed research showing smaller scale is more efficient (rare because institution funding research is invested in scale)

C023.observable: fraction of documented substrates excluded from institutional funding / publication / policy

bounds.spatial: the institutional research field around autonomous logistics

conditions: substrate inventory is comprehensive of plausible alternatives
exclusion verified against funding / publication / policy channels
invalid_if: substantive funded program studying decentralized / symbiotic / degraded-mode alternatives at parity with institution-scaled programs
data_source: Web of Science / Scopus indexed publications

C024.observable: 5-phase collapse cycle position with adaptive capacity score
C024.rate_equation: d(adaptive_capacity)/d(ratio_to_optimum) = -1 above 1.5x optimum, modulated by observed response
conditions: optimal_size known
observed_response in {doubled_down, partial, successful_adapt}
invalid_if: large institution successfully adapts to fundamental market / resource constraint without collapse
measured_by: historical institution case studies (Roman, Soviet, Blockbuster, Kodak, ICE auto, 2008 financial)

C025.observable: 10-year probability of any of 7 preconditions failing, weighted by degraded-mode capability

bounds.spatial: fleet operating across one or more national jurisdictions

conditions: deployment_type assigned (autonomous_no_driver / hybrid_with_safety_driver / fully_remote_operator / human_driver_only)
earth_system_trends within 2026-2036 envelope
invalid_if: autonomous deployment that remains operational through a 24-hour regional power outage AND satellite signal loss AND 72-hour regional internet disruption AND 6-month critical-parts supply break AND geopolitical rare-earth embargo

C026.observable: destabilization-mechanism count across 5 economic-model coupling effects
C026.rate_equation: d(double_bind)/d(deployment_scale) = +1 per mechanism activated by deployment

bounds.spatial: automation deployment within its economic system

conditions: mechanism inventory enumerated against canonical 5-mechanism list
destabilization_strength scored per mechanism
invalid_if: automation deployment that does not depend on continuous growth, has supply-chain diversification adequate to absorb any single jurisdiction's restriction, and demonstrates resilience to economic shock without external bailout

C027.observable: 5-test validity battery against claim text (energy-grounded, optimization reduces energy, causal, scarcity-robust, models failure)

bounds.spatial: any economic claim about an automation deployment

conditions: claim is in natural language or structured dict
energy-grounding regex patterns include domain vocabulary
invalid_if: economic model that predicts outcomes accurately during conditions of resource scarcity (where money != energy)

bounds.spatial: institution operating on a non-energy-grounded model

conditions: organization_type classified
alternative_models_available counted
invalid_if: economic model that successfully adapts to fundamental resource scarcity without institutional collapse or reversal

C029.observable: fraction of 9 capital forms with nonzero entries in deployment's reported accounting
conditions: reported accounting is what the operator publishes (10-K, sustainability report, marketing pitch)
9 capital forms enumerated against canonical list
invalid_if: financial deployment publishing audited per-period accounting that includes nonzero entries against all nine capital forms with comparable denominators
sensitivity: which capital forms are externalized (typically all but financial+labor)

C030.observable: joules-equivalent deficit (sum of non-financial capital losses minus financial capital gain) over 30-year horizon
conditions: joules-per-unit conversion factors specified (defaults: financial 3.6e6, environmental 3.0e9/ton CO2, etc.)
all 9 capital forms have annual extraction values
invalid_if: large-scale automation deployment where financial_capital_gained > sum(all_other_capital_losses) when all capitals are denominated in comparable units (joules-equivalent or years-to-recovery)

bounds.spatial: any economic model used for billion-dollar deployment decisions

conditions: claim is a structured dict OR text containing regime / design-margin / falsifier markers
definition and input stability scores reflect current institutional posture
invalid_if: published economic model that satisfies all four engineering-grade criteria explicitly and has been third-party-audited under stress
data_source: NASA / DNV / NRC engineering validation documentation
FRED / BLS / USGS input volatility data

C032.observable: regime-validation coverage + training-to-deployment regime drift severity

bounds.spatial: AI deployment operating on an economic model

conditions: model carries regimes_validated list
training_regime and deployment_regime classified against 4-regime taxonomy
invalid_if: AI economic model that successfully predicts outcomes during a fundamental market regime shift (supply shock, geopolitical disruption, currency devaluation, regulatory overhaul)
measured_by: historical cascade cases (LTCM, 2008, 2010 flash crash, March 2020)
